items.name: MvPolynomial.natDegree_optionEquivLeft
items.type: (R : Type u) {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R) : ((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R σ) p).natDegree = MvPolynomial.degreeOf none p

items.name: MvPolynomial.degree_optionEquivLeft
items.type: (R : Type u) {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R} (h : f ≠ 0) : ((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R σ) f).degree = ↑(MvPolynomial.degreeOf none f)

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_eq_natDegree
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] [DecidableEq σ] (a : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : MvPolynomial.degreeOf a p = ((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R { b // b ≠ a }) ((MvPolynomial.rename ⇑(Equiv.optionSubtypeNe a).symm) p)).natDegree
